title: Pinat
tagline: A Farcaster frame that gives the information of some the best bridges in web3 that support Optimism
description:
A Farcaster frame that gives the information of some the best bridges in web3 that support Optimism
These bridges include Circle CCTP, Hop Protocol, Stargate Protocol and the Across Protocol by UMA
Would like to add more details in future like liquidity, transfers etc , will try to have a dynamic image in frames that can display this information without the user having the click on link
how_its_made:
I tried using the Onchain Kit template https://github.com/Zizzamia/a-frame-in-100-lines created by Coinbase and Base chain team

However I decided to go static vanilla html instead.
This allowed me to test and build faster

Used Html and Farcaster meta tags to build the project.

Warpcast and XTMP for frame interactivity

Netlify to host the frame on a server and the DefiLlama for bridge information
